name: Soya Kofta Curry
steps: Soak soya granules in boiling water for 10 minutes, drain and squeeze very dry. Chop finely; blend cashews with 80 ml of the measured water until smooth.
Mix squeezed soya with mashed potato, chickpea flour, 4 g salt and half the coriander leaves. Shape 12 compact kofta balls; chill 10 minutes so they hold together.
Heat 75 ml oil in a deep pan. Fry kofta in batches on medium heat for 5–6 minutes until deep golden; drain on paper.

In a separate pan, heat remaining oil and cook onion 7 minutes. Add ginger-garlic paste, tomato puree, coriander powder, chili and remaining salt; cook 8 minutes until thick. Stir in cashew paste and remaining 220 ml water.
Simmer gravy 5 minutes, then add garam masala. Put kofta in the serving bowl and spoon gravy over them just before eating; garnish with remaining coriander.
tips: Squeezing soaked soya thoroughly prevents spongy, fragile kofta.
notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.
